notes: BaskVault is the sole application deployment: Basket Protocol's index vault for Stock Tokens on Robinhood Chain (chain id 4663). Basket (BASK) is the vault's own 18-decimal ERC-20 share, with zero supply at deployment and no supply cap; deposits mint shares and redemptions burn shares. Constructor arguments are the approved owner and guardian literals, in that order. The constructor makes no external calls. The owner lists assets with their feeds and pools during genesis; deposits open after finalizeGenesis with at least three assets. The fee recipient starts unset, with no fees charged. Setting it requires an owner proposal, a two-day wait and owner execution within the following seven days; once set, the fixed deposit and redemption fee is 50 bps, rounded up. Redemptions read no prices and ignore deposit pauses; failed direct payments and deferred payments are recorded as owed to the receiver for later claim. No separate launch token, pool or website is deployed.
